title: getSpecFile
description: Information about the API specification file.

createdBy.description: The user ID of the user that created the file.

updatedBy.description: The ID of the user who updated the file.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the file was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time at which the file was updated.

type.description:
The type of file:
- `ROOT` — A file containing the full OpenAPI structure and references other (DEFAULT) spec files.
- `DEFAULT` — A file referenced by the `ROOT` file.
